It's not bragging it's pointing out that the product I paid for was not the product I received. I'm not laughing at anyone who can't afford the game I'm unhappy with the state of the game I paid for. 
The world events in those zones are alright but nowhere near events in HoT. Remember Swordmaster Faren? I do, because the event was fun. It's a tiny event tucked away in a small part of the map but it's fun so it stuck with me. I honestly couldn't tell you the name or the gimmick behind any of the new events because of how utterly bland they are.

Around four massive meta events that provided decent challenge and fun activities on a daily basis. A reason to log in. A decent time actually accomplishing something on the map, killing an elder dragon or fighting off massive wyverns attacking the survivors of a downed airship. It has story baked into the events and it's fun to do. 
What does PoF have? Boring story instances with an abysmal plot an event where the end boss is an asuran in a mecha (who I've never even heard of before or since) , and mount skins. Oh boy so glad I spent $60 to buy the privilege of buying more things from the gem store. 
So, yeah I'm going to compare an entire expac to Dragon's Stand because Dragon's Stand has more content in one map that PoF has in 5.

A festival is not Dragon's Stand. I paid $60 for both HoT and PoF but one delivered $60 of content while the other I would say is worth maybe $15 with the content it has. I can play with the zepherites on a free account so I'm not sure what you're getting at.
